scope_note: *.duna.com - everything in scope, including vendor-hosted infra running Duna code or storing Duna data. Duna is AI-native KYB/KYC compliance infrastructure (business onboarding, periodic reviews). App tier (api/dashboard/connect/contribute/webhooks/events/admin) is self-hosted on AWS eu-central-1 (3.76.148.43, 18.194.122.18). Auth is WorkOS AuthKit (auth/auth-api/auth-admin via Cloudflare, client_id client_01JNR708GP08A6X4D265YCSEPD). Marketing on Framer, CDN on S3+CloudFront, docs on ReadMe (password-gated), help on Mintlify, status on incident.io/Vercel, KB on HubSpot, forms on Tally. KYC vendors Onfido + idNow embedded in connect/contribute (in-scope where they store Duna data). settings.duna.com referenced in app CSP but NXDOMAIN publicly = internal/origin-exposure candidate. PHASE2: production duna.com namespace exhausted - 66-name curated DNS sweep (staging/dev/internal/admin-api/grafana/etc) all NXDOMAIN; no forgotten prod host beyond the 27 known. All non-prod naming lives under the Duna-owned alias domains. withduna.com = Duna STAGING/DEV env on a SEPARATE AWS eu-central-1 LB (3.125.250.148/3.126.170.142) running the same app set (admin/api/connect/contribute/dashboard/events/webhooks/github-app + dashboard-proto/demo on Vercel). duna.io = production alias (api/dashboard/connect.duna.io point at the PROD LB 3.76.148.43/18.194.122.18; cdn.duna.io CloudFront; know.duna.io same HubSpot). viaduna.com = CDN alias. All Duna-owned (Key-Systems GmbH registrar, AWS Route53 NS; withduna+viaduna batch-registered same second 2023-07-10; serve/route Duna code+data) => in scope per CLAUDE.md scope clarification. Recommend bringing withduna.com into active scope - highest-value new surface.
ruled_out: cPanel service subdomains cpanel/cpcalendars/whm/webdisk/webmail/mail.duna.com are all NXDOMAIN - no cPanel hosting in use, dead.

api.duna.com has NO GraphQL (/graphql 404), NO public OpenAPI (/openapi.json 404), NO OIDC discovery (/.well-known/openid-configuration 404), NO robots. All data routes are auth-gated; only /health is public (200 {"status":"ok"}).
crt.sh returned no new live subdomains beyond the known set; only net-new name is settings.duna.com (from CSP, NXDOMAIN).
WorkOS client_id and Datadog/Sentry public RUM/ingest keys in CSPs are public-by-design, not findings on their own (per CLAUDE.md known non-findings).

connect/contribute onboarding-session IDOR ASSESSED, boundary PRESENT (no finding). API at https://connect.duna.com/internal/*. Onboarding session = TypeID onbo_<26 crockford-base32> (128-bit, UUIDv7-backed; connection=conn_<...>); 25/27-char IDs rejected 400 invalid_onboarding_id. IDs are cryptographically random (48-bit ms time + 74 random bits), NOT sequential/guessable - enumeration infeasible. Every data route (/internal/onboardings/{id}, /featureflags, /internal/{id}/access, /settings/customization/{id}, /settings/support/{id}) requires a server-VALIDATED session carried via duna-session-id (session_*): a valid-format non-existent ID returns 401 (no 404 existence-oracle, no data); a forged session header/cookie is rejected 401. Session is invite/share-link bootstrapped. No IDOR, no missing-authz, no ID predictability confirmed. No real PII retrieved.

api.duna.com CORS is static ACAO:* with NO Access-Control-Allow-Credentials = safe wildcard, not the dangerous combo. Error handling clean (no stack traces/versions/paths), path traversal normalized. Full Helmet header set.

auth-api.duna.com OPTIONS preflight on /user_management/* and /sso/* reflects arbitrary Origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true, BUT actual GET/POST responses carry no ACAO/ACAC, and auth is bearer-token (not cookie) based -> not exploitable. WorkOS-operated host, default posture.
api.duna.com unauth probes all 404 (.well-known/*, openapi.json, swagger[.json], api-docs, graphql, metrics, debug, version, status, healthz, ready, favicon). Only /health public.

Host-header routing on app LB reaches dashboard/connect vhosts via shared LB, but admin.duna.com / settings.duna.com / auth-admin.duna.com return bare 404 (vhosts not configured on public LB). Admin app unreachable from edge. Dead end.
WorkOS AuthKit redirect_uri is validated against allowlist: off-domain redirect_uri -> 302 to /redirect-uri-invalid. No open redirect.

Security headers strong on dashboard (HSTS includeSubDomains, strict CSP nonce+strict-dynamic, XFO, COOP/CORP, locked permissions-policy) and auth (HSTS preload). CF __cf_bm/_cfuvid cookies correctly HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None.

webhooks.duna.com exposes only GET /health; no inbound webhook route reachable by path enumeration (opaque per-provider secret paths). Signature/replay/SSRF tests blocked without a real webhook URL (manual step).

events.duna.com is an authenticated Segment-style analytics collector requiring a valid write_key/api_key; bogus keys rejected, no public key in bundles, CORS * without credentials. Not unauthenticated event injection. No stored XSS reachable (error reflection is application/json).

SELF-SERVICE SIGNUP = NOT AVAILABLE from this environment (gate task completed). A usable dashboard session CANNOT be obtained self-service with curl. See open_threads gate entry + pending_decisions for exact blockers and what is needed.

Curated 66-name DNS sweep on *.duna.com (staging,stage,dev,test,qa,uat,sandbox,preview,app,portal,backoffice,admin-api,internal,int,api-staging,api-dev,dashboard-staging,dashboard-dev,beta,next,legacy,v1,v2,gateway,grafana,kibana,prometheus,jenkins,ci,gitlab,vault,argocd,vpn,bastion,jump,monitoring,metrics,logs,db,storage,files,assets,media,blog,careers,help,kb,partners,developers,sdk,mobile,m,old,new,auth-staging,api-internal,internal-api,sentry,runner,settings,config,demo,dashboard-proto,graphql,n8n,github-app) = ALL NXDOMAIN. No forgotten/staging/internal host on the duna.com apex beyond the 27 known.

vhost probing on prod app LB via Host-header override (CONNECT api.duna.com, override Host): only dashboard(->/login), connect(->/onboard), api route. settings/staging/internal/admin-api/api-internal/graphql/dashboard-proto/grafana/admin/auth-admin/config/preview .duna.com all return bare empty 404 with NO Server header = no vhost on public LB. Admin/settings unreachable from edge - confirmed dead end.
certspotter + crt.sh CT sweep for duna.com net-new = only cdn.duna.io (alias-domain cross-SAN), nothing new under duna.com itself.
open_threads: api.duna.com - core REST API (Express/Helmet, CORS *). Auth-gated data routes behind WorkOS bearer. HIGHEST VALUE: object-by-ID IDOR / cross-tenant read once a session is obtained. Error format endpoint_does_not_exist confirms known-route router. Needs authenticated WorkOS session. STILL BLOCKED on obtaining a session - see gate entry.

webhooks.duna.com - Express/Helmet, CSP default-src none. Only GET /health (200 {status:ok}) reachable; GET / and ~60 POST paths (all provider names, generic, /v1|/api|/webhooks prefixes, nested, trailing-slash) all return Express default 404 'Cannot POST /x' => no inbound route registered at any guessable path. Inbound webhook routes use opaque per-provider secret path segments. BLOCKED: signature-verify/replay/SSRF untestable without a real webhook URL. MANUAL: obtain one actual provider webhook URL from Duna or capture a real inbound request via Burp.

events.duna.com - Segment/RudderStack-compatible collector (nginx/1.28.2). Routes /track /batch /identify; others invalid_request_path. REQUIRES valid write_key/api_key (bogus -> 'Invalid write key: X'); no key exposed in client bundles (frontend uses Amplitude direct). CORS * but no allow-credentials. NOT unauthenticated injection - recon assumption refuted. No finding; only reopen if a valid write/api key leaks elsewhere.
cdn.duna.com - S3 (AmazonS3 origin) behind CloudFront. Test bucket listing/writeability and scan all SPA bundles for baked config, API base paths, and secrets.

docs.duna.com - ReadMe API docs, whole site password-gated (302 /password). If reachable, it is the full authenticated api.duna.com route map/OpenAPI. Try public ReadMe project slug / shared password.

SELF-REGISTRATION GATE RESOLVED = BLOCKED. No self-service path to a dashboard session from this environment. (1) No Duna-side signup: marketing duna.com only CTA 'Get started' -> https://duna.com/forms/get-in-touch (lead form); dashboard.duna.com/login 302 -> WorkOS AuthKit authorize only; /auth/callback?code=bogus -> 302 /auth/failure. (2) WorkOS AuthKit /sign-up route EXISTS (api.workos.com/user_management/authorize + screen_hint=sign-up -> auth-api -> auth.duna.com/sign-up) but is gated by a Cloudflare INTERACTIVE JS challenge (HTTP 403 'Just a moment...', cdn-cgi/challenge-platform chl_page) that a curl/non-browser client cannot solve. The login screen (auth.duna.com/) loads 200, but /sign-up is CF-challenged specifically. (3) AuthKit sign-up requires email OTP verification to a real mailbox - none reachable/controllable from this environment; guardrails forbid operator real email (250480@buas.nl) and any real PII. (4) Dashboard access very likely requires org membership/invite: Duna hosted signup path is /internal/sign-up/{configurationId}/{hostedSignUpId} with invite-link random TypeIDs, and the AuthKit message catalog carries 'Application access denied. Please contact your administrator.', 'Registration denied', invitation-required and waitlist strings. NEXT: needs user/Duna action - see pending_decisions.
settings.duna.com still NXDOMAIN publicly and not host-routed on the public LB; only origin-IP/internal exposure path remains (needs internal vantage or passive-DNS pivot). Lower priority.

PASSIVE-ONLY so far per RoE (DNS+RDAP+2 root GETs). NEEDS user confirmation to actively test. pending_decisions: AUTH ACCESS BLOCKER - need ONE of the following from the user/Duna to unblock the two highest-value threads (api.duna.com IDOR + onboarding cross-tenant), ideally provisioning TWO tenants/users for the cross-account IDOR test: (a) a provisioned test tenant with 2 users, OR (b) one valid hosted sign-up invite link https://dashboard.duna.com/internal/sign-up/{configurationId}/{hostedSignUpId} PLUS a usable test mailbox the operator controls for the OTP, OR (c) explicit confirmation that WorkOS self-signup + NEW-org creation is enabled, together with a browser able to solve the Cloudflare /sign-up challenge and a reachable test mailbox. Self-service via curl is not possible (CF interactive challenge on /sign-up + email OTP + probable org/invite requirement).
